Research and Analysis of Association Rules Algorithm on Drug Interaction in Cardiovascular System Based on FP Growth
LI Yaa ， WANG Yia ， YU Leia ， MA Chuna ， YAN Gui⁃mingb（ a． School of Medical Information Engineering； b． School of Integrated Traditional and Western Medicine， Anhui University of Chinese Medicine， Hefei 230012， China）Abstract： Cardiovascular disease is a common and multiple disease in clinic． The combination of drugs is a common clinical treatment for this kind of disease． In this paper， in view of the frequent occurrence of adverse events in combination medication， FP growth algorithm is proposed to mine and analyze the data of drug－drug interaction in cardiovascular system， so as to explore the relationship between avoiding drug combination，cautious drug combination and the value of drug factors that can be used in combination in cardiovascular system drugs， and the rules of drug use among some cardiovascular system drugs are summarized， which can provide references for clinical drug use．心血管疾病是临床上常见与多发的一种疾病随着我国人口老龄化现象日趋严重以及居民生活习惯的变化心血管疾病的发生率逐年上升［1］ 联合用药是治疗心血管疾病过程中较为常见的临床治疗手段能够有效提高患者的临床治疗效果但如果用药不合理也会产生系列不良反应因此对心血管疾病联合用药进行研究具有重要的指导意义和现实意义本文运用基于关联规则的 － 算法利用相关书籍［2－3］中的心血管系统药物数据来探讨心血管系统药物之间相互作用规律为临床合理用药提供参考
